app.title: TheoremFeed
home.title: Your study feed
home.empty.title: Upload your material
home.empty.body: Your feed only shows videos for concepts in your study material. Add a text-based PDF of your notes or textbook to get started.
home.empty.cta_soon: Material upload arrives in the next build.
gap.title: No videos yet: {concept}
gap.body: You're studying this concept but have no videos for it yet.
shorts.empty.title: No theorem shorts yet
shorts.empty.body: Build the curated math theorem pool once. The app searches YouTube for short clips of each theorem and keeps only English, educational, safe ones.
concept.out_of_scope: Not in your material or the theorem pool, so videos for it aren't collected.
ingest.needs_key: Add your Claude API key in Settings first.
ingest.bad_key: Your Claude API key was rejected. Check it in Settings.
settings.title: Settings
settings.key.title: Claude API key
settings.key.body: Used to check that videos are educational and safe (and, later, to read your PDFs). Stored encrypted on this phone and sent only to api.anthropic.com.
settings.pool.title: Theorem pool
settings.pool.body: {shorts} shorts for {theorems} curated theorems. Building searches YouTube for each theorem and runs every candidate through the three gates. Safe to re-run; it continues where it left off.
settings.privacy.title: What leaves this phone
settings.privacy.body: YouTube: searches for your concepts and theorem names, and video streams. Anthropic: video titles, descriptions, transcript excerpts and thumbnail links for checking, and later text from your PDFs. Nothing else: no accounts, no analytics.
